replayRefused.how: The same run made a second attempt under the same grant. It was refused: 'grant PROJECTOS-DEGRADED-WITNESS2-GRANT1B was already used and cannot be replayed onto further work'. ONE MEANS ONE, demonstrated rather than asserted.

whatWasProven: The canonical route runs and binds correctly: 'every check passed; asking would send request GKREQ-fabdf74e13b02e5d460510df about 907b9a2' — project, phase, work id, grant, subject and owner all checked.
The dry run sent nothing, spent nothing and wrote nothing.
The real attempt refused as UNAVAILABLE, reported that the request was never sent and nothing was spent, and left the debt standing.

Mismatched bindings are refused, each naming the exact mismatch: a work id the grant does not record (NOT_OUTSTANDING), a phase the use record is not for (NO_SUCH_GRANT), and a grant with no use record and no installation spend (NO_SUCH_GRANT).
The debt was never discharged by any of them.
limb3_returnToGatekeeperReconciliation.whyItCannotComplete: Reconciliation needs the gatekeeper's actual verdict, and this witness can never obtain one: it exists outside the installation's committed credential allowlist, which is precisely the boundary that produced the unavailability in the first place. A witness built to be unreachable cannot also be reachable. Completing this limb requires the installation to authorise the witness — an installation-side governance change that would also spend real money — and that is an owner and gatekeeper decision, not an implementer's.
limb3_returnToGatekeeperReconciliation.notFaked: No verdict was manufactured, no reconciliation record was written, and the debt stands outstanding exactly as the runtime reports it.

correctionsMadeToReachThisPoint.f8OnTheReconcileRoute: The reconcile route had the same classification defect the loop had, and the same ordering problem: it never forwarded the installation policy to the transport, never released its reservation, and asked the policy only after admission — so admission refused first and the classification was never reached. All three were corrected to match the loop, which is what turned a permanently stuck SPEND_REFUSED into an honest UNAVAILABLE that reports nothing was sent.
correctionsMadeToReachThisPoint.residual: The reconcile reservation of 8405 micro-USD is RETAINED rather than released, because releasing requires the installation's answered-record to say the request was never answered and that record does not exist on this installation. That is the F7 fail-safe behaving as specified: it keeps a charge that may be wrong rather than erasing one that may be real. It blocks nothing, because the policy is now checked before admission.

recommendation: DO NOT ACCEPT C11 YET. Limbs 1 and 2 are proven end to end, durably, with replay and mismatched bindings refused. Limb 3 is attempted and correctly refused, but cannot complete while the witness sits outside the installation allowlist — the same boundary that makes limb 1 real. The gatekeeper should decide whether to authorise the witness for one reconciliation call, which would spend real money and is an installation-side change, or to accept limb 3 as proven by the parent project's own reconciliation route instead.
